description: State Ministry of Indigenous Medicine Promotion - Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Ayurvedic Medical Service
categorisation: This gazette content contains the Service Minute of the Sri Lanka Ayurvedic Medical Service, which outlines public service recruitment, grades, salaries, and service conditions for Ayurvedic medical officers. It deals specifically with public sector service administration, including salary scales, post classifications, and service structure, falling under Public Service Gazettes (Type 8) rather than government personnel changes or other specialized categories.
